thread:
maria_customer: Hi, our trial org (org_zen) ran ~150 short chat completions but the trial balance still reads 1000 credits. We called the SDK concurrently from a browser app — can you check?

elaine_support: Sorry about that — can you DM the request IDs or paste one example trace here? we'll triage.

maria_customer: here's a sample request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. I grabbed a har log from the browser. header snip below.

maria_customer: ```
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx
X-Client-Id: web-frontend
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c3d
X-Experiment: batch-stream-v2
X-Synthetic: true
```

trent_engineering: interesting — that X-Synthetic header shouldn't be on user requests. @kyle_prod any rollout notes?

kyle_prod: we did roll a rate-limiter experiment that tags retried requests with X-Synthetic: true so the RL service can short-circuit some telemetry. it was supposed to be internal-only at the gateway level. theoretically the header should be stripped before the request hits the accounting path.

elaine_support: billing-bot can you check ledger for req_0a1b2c3d and similar IDs?

billing-bot: Found 142 requests with X-Request-Id pattern req_0a1b2c3*. Ledger shows zero debit for those. Matching completed responses (200) with token fields present, but debit step skipped.

ops_replay: Replay logs show the accounting service checks headers and has this condition: `if headers['x-synthetic'] == 'true' then skip_debit = true` — looks like the experiment inadvertently marked real customer traffic when the gateway couldn't attribute retries.

trent_engineering: Ugh. The intended flow was `gateway adds x-synthetic` -> `gateway strips before accounting` but a config flag `forward-experiment-headers=true` was toggled during canary. So accounting saw the header.

maria_customer: So the tokens were used but not charged? What's the impact and fix?

elaine_support: short-term: we will credit back the trial wallet to match expected consumption and follow up with an incident summary. engineering: any hotfix ETA?

trent_engineering: Hotfix plan — revert the gateway config to strip experiment headers immediately (roll back the canary), and remove `x-synthetic` check from accounting to avoid future accidental skips. Then run a backfill job to compute token deltas from traces. Hotfix ETA 45m for config rollback, backfill ETA ~3 hours depending on repro window.

kyle_prod: rolling back canary now. patching the gateway to strip header in our ingress filter.

billing-bot: Backfill job started in dry-run mode. It will scan traces for requests with X-Request-Id pattern and where response had token usage >0 but ledger debit == 0, then create corrective debit entries with a special tag `auto-correct/synthetic-header-bug`.

ops_replay: We should also add a monitoring alert for ledger-skew where completed_requests - debited_requests > threshold in a short window.

elaine_support: Thanks. Maria — we'll update your account once the backfill finishes and I'll CC you on the incident note. Apologies for the disruption. :heart:

maria_customer: thanks for the quick action. can you confirm I won't be billed beyond the free-trial allowance for these corrections?

elaine_support: yes — corrections will only debit trial credits on your account, not charge payment method. we'll confirm the final numbers in the follow-up.

trent_engineering: postmortem action items I wrote down: 1) remove synthetic header gating in accounting 2) ensure ingress strips experiment headers 3) add ledger-skew alert 4) add unit test for header propagation 5) run backfill and verify idempotency.

kyle_prod: can someone from SRE run the backfill on staging first to validate idempotency? ops_replay volunteering.

ops_replay: will run staging then prod. posting replay job commands in case useful: 

```
# dry-run
python tools/backfill_ledger.py --source traces --match-header X-Request-Id=req_0a1b2c3* --dry-run

# apply
python tools/backfill_ledger.py --source traces --match-header X-Request-Id=req_0a1b2c3* --apply --tag auto-correct/synthetic-header-bug
```

billing-bot: dry-run found 152 candidate requests for org_zen -> estimated debit 0.013 credits (very small).

elaine_support: I'll message you directly when the correction posts. putting a follow-up thread for the incident summary. thanks everyone. :pray:
